subject: Compliance roadmap: ISO scope clarification & FedRAMP evidence scheduling
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@sentinelbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sentinel Bank Compliance <compliance@sentinelbank.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: ISO scope + FedRAMP evidence timeline

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re lining up our vendor intake for an upcoming internal audit and BrightAudit will be running a FedRAMP readiness check in October. Before we lock calendar slots, can you confirm Redwood’s intended ISO 27001 scope (systems-in-scope vs out-of-scope) and whether you have a mapping of SIG/CAIQ control families to your current evidence artifacts?

Specific asks:
- Short summary of what Redwood will claim as in-scope for ISO 27001 (services, data flows, managed keys).
- A lightweight index (sample filenames + brief description) of artifacts you can provide for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ (logs, configuration screenshots, policy docs, KMS attestation).
- A proposed 2-week window (preferred dates) when BrightAudit can request evidence for dry-run extraction.

We’re on a tight timeline and would like to include this in the mutual action plan for procurement. Can you share the above by end of day Wednesday?

Best,
James Porter
Head of Vendor Risk
Sentinel Bank

--
attachments: none (initial request)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@sentinelbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: ISO scope + FedRAMP evidence timeline

Hi James — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate the timeline note. Quick replies below and a proposed next step.

High-level ISO 27001 scope (draft):
- In-scope: Redwood inference control plane (control APIs, model serving orchestration), customer-facing inference API endpoints for hosted and dedicated environments, and the control-plane metadata stores that handle model versioning and routing.
- Out-of-scope: customer-managed private VPC compute and on-prem hardware (customers that self-host are out-of-scope for our ISO-covered assets).
- Data flows: we will provide a concise diagram showing telemetry, logs, and how customer data is isolated; KMS usage is documented and we’ll include key-wrap details for hosted keys.

Evidence index (attached): redwood_evidence_index.pdf — contains sample artifact names (policy docs, ACL screenshots, config exports, log retention statements, KMS key rotation logs). The attachment is a living index; we’ve flagged items that typically satisfy SIG/CAIQ questions and which are SOC 2-ready.

Proposed dry-run windows (BrightAudit):
- Option A: Sep 7–18, 2026 (preferred)
- Option B: Sep 21–Oct 2, 2026

Next step: can we schedule a 45-minute intake call Wed Aug 11 or Thu Aug 12 to walk the BrightAudit team through the index and agree on sampling? I’ll bring Karthik for evidence owners and Markus for scope/controls.

I’m attaching the evidence index now and a small draft scope matrix (redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx) to speed triage.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites once you confirm a slot.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
attachments: redwood_evidence_index.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@sentinelbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: ISO scope + FedRAMP evidence timeline

Thanks James / Irene — a few clarification points and a proposed mutual action plan so procurement and audit teams can track deliverables.

Quick clarifications:
- When you ask for "mapping of SIG/CAIQ control families to artifacts", do you want a control-by-control crosswalk or just a per-family pointer to representative artifacts? We can produce both; a full crosswalk will take ~5 business days.
- For FedRAMP readiness requests: are BrightAudit looking for SSP-level artifacts (system security plan) or sample evidence only? We do maintain an SSP-like package internally (not yet FedRAMP-certified), and can push a redacted snapshot for review.

Proposed mutual action plan (high-level):
1) Intake call — agree scope and sampling (week of Aug 11) — owner: Irene — due Aug 12
2) Deliver draft control crosswalk (family-level pointers) — owner: Karthik — due Aug 17
3) Provide redacted SSP snapshot + evidence index to BrightAudit — owner: Markus — due Sep 1
4) Dry-run extraction window (logs/configs) — agreed window Sep 7–18 — owner: Operations (cc-ed)
5) Finalize evidence handoff + auditor access details — owner: Marissa — due Sep 25

I’ll create a shared doc for the crosswalk and tag each artifact with an internal owner and expected extraction method (console export, csv, or signed attestation). Link to draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF-Compliance-Shared (internal).

If that timeline looks tight for your calendar, propose alternative windows and we’ll adjust.

On a practical note: please have BrightAudit send a short intake (2–3 bullet questions) in advance so we can prestage artifacts and reduce back-and-forth during the dry-run.

-Karthik
Sr. Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

--
attachments: draft_map_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@sentinelbank.com>, BrightAudit LLP <audit@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: ISO scope + FedRAMP evidence timeline — intake confirmed

James / BrightAudit team — thanks for confirming availability. Confirming items from our side and next steps below.

1) Intake call: Thu Aug 12, 2026 at 10:00am PT (45 min). Calendar invite sent to James and BrightAudit. Agenda: quick scope diagram, review redwood_evidence_index.pdf, agree family-level sampling for SIG/CAIQ, and confirm dry-run checklist.

2) Deliverables we will provide ahead of the call (by end of Aug 11 EOD):
- redwood_evidence_index.pdf (attached) — index of representative artifacts and owners.
- redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx (attached) — mapping of service boundaries and in-scope components.
- draft_map_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx — family-level pointers for control evidence.

3) Dry-run window: targeting Sep 7–18 — operations will provision auditor access patterns; we’ll circulate the dry-run checklist and required access accounts.

4) Requested from BrightAudit / Sentinel before the intake:
- Clarify whether you prefer a full control-by-control crosswalk or family-level pointers (we can scope the former after intake).
- If FedRAMP-style SSP artifacts are required, please confirm a redaction policy for customer-identifying details.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_index.pdf; redwood_iso_scope_matrix.xlsx; draft_map_SIG-CAIQ.xlsx

If anyone needs the invite moved, reply-all with alternate times. Looking forward to a productive intake.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
